msg: It seemed like at times the green/brown knomes were linked and the red/purple ones were too. At other times it didn't. What worked well for me is:start by clicking the red/purple knome each time,if you get a yield 5 and above, continue clicking the same knome colours (Red/ Purple).if you get a yield below 5, change the colour of the knome you are clicking (brown/green).Some periods all knomes give low, some periods all knomes give high, some periods colour pairs will give high while the other gives low.Follow those two steps in the sentences starting with 'if'.DON'T FORGET TO CLICK SPACE ON THE FORREST.
